---
title: "nf-metaomics-daisychain Documentation"
---

Here is the user documentation for nf-metaomics-daisychain. It is a
meta-pipeline that includes several pipelines from [nf-core](https://nf-co.re/).

![](images/nf-metaomics-daisychain.png)

## Quickstart

Write a `meta-pipeline-params.yml` that turns on which pipelines you want to
daisy-chain together with their `enable_<pipeline>` boolean:

```{.yml}
enable_fetchngs: true
enable_taxprofiler: true
general:
  wf_opts: '-resume -ansi-log false -profile docker'
```

Enabling a pipeline that has no auto-wired upstream in the chain (or whose upstream
is itself disabled) requires giving it its own `input`/`params_file` (see below) -
`nextflow_schema.json` checks this before any pipeline starts, rather than letting
the pipeline fail deep into a run for lack of input.

For each pipeline you want to run, you'll need to create a `params.{yml,json}` file (Ideally name it after the pipeline e.g., `fetchngs-params.yml`).
You can do this with `nf-core pipelines launch <pipeline>`, or use the launch
page on the nf-core website. For non-nf-core pipelines, you'll have to create
this manually. In most cases you'll be forced to enter a value for `--input`, but
that should be removed before using the meta-pipeline.

Add these files to your `meta-pipeline-params.yml` under each pipeline's own block:

```{.yml}
fetchngs:
  params_file: 'tests/params/fetchngs-params.json'
...
```

Command line interface instructions can also be added per pipeline as `wf_opts`,
alongside a `general.wf_opts` that applies to every pipeline in the chain:

```{.yml}
general:
  wf_opts: '-resume -ansi-log false -profile docker'
fetchngs:
  wf_opts: '-r 1.12.0'
taxprofiler:
  wf_opts: '-r 2.0.1 -profile test'
```

Custom configs can also be added similarly, as `add_config`:

```{.yml}
fetchngs:
  add_config: 'configs/multiqc.config'
taxprofiler:
  add_config: 'configs/multiqc.config'
```

A samplesheet can be supplied or overridden directly with `input`, taking
precedence over both a previous pipeline's generated samplesheet and any `input`
declared inside `params_file`:

```{.yml}
taxprofiler:
  input: '/absolute/path/to/samplesheet.csv'
```

The meta-pipeline is then run using:

```{.bash}
nextflow run mahesh-panchal/nf-metaomics-daisychain -params-file meta-pipeline-params.yml
```
